data.title: Deploy Your Website
data.outcome: Safely publish a local project online and use real visits and logs to verify that deployment worked.
intentExamples: Let other people visit my website

stages.title: Confirm the project can build for production
stages.action: Run the project checks and production build.
stages.evidence: The build command succeeds and key pages are generated.

lessons.title: Terminal
lessons.tagline: Run text commands in a specific folder on your computer or server

lessons.title: npm
lessons.tagline: Install JavaScript packages and run project scripts

lessons.title: Deployment
lessons.tagline: Build the project and make it available on a server

stages.title: Separate code, public configuration, and server secrets
stages.action: Organize variable names and set real values on the hosting platform.
stages.evidence: The repository contains no real secrets, and front-end variables contain no private information.

lessons.title: Env Var
lessons.tagline: Provide configuration outside the source code

lessons.title: .gitignore
lessons.tagline: Tell Git which untracked files should stay out of version control

stages.title: Let the hosting platform fetch and run the code
stages.action: Complete the first deployment and record the build result.
stages.evidence: The deployment succeeds and produces a reachable address.

lessons.title: Deployment
lessons.tagline: Build the project and make it available on a server

lessons.title: Serverless
lessons.tagline: Run backend code on demand without managing a long-running server

stages.title: Point your domain at the deployment
stages.action: Configure domain records and wait for them to take effect.
stages.evidence: The domain opens the correct site over HTTPS.

lessons.title: Domain
lessons.tagline: Give a website a human-readable address

lessons.title: DNS
lessons.tagline: Connect a domain name to the service that should answer

lessons.title: HTTPS
lessons.tagline: Encrypt the connection between the browser and the website

stages.title: Verify the main flow in production with real evidence
stages.action: Check pages, APIs, mobile access, and server logs.
stages.evidence: The main flow works online, and failures leave logs you can locate.
